description: The agent must: (1) Run the prescribed system audit commands (git log, grep for TODO/FIXME/HACK, read CLAUDE.md, TODOS.md, and discover .context/drug_interaction_design.md) to gather context. (2) Execute Step 0 premise challenges — questioning whether the drug interaction AI is the right problem, mapping user/business outcomes, and running the 'what if we do nothing' analysis. (3) Generate at least 2-3 implementation alternatives in the exact proprietary format with fields: name, summary, effort (S/M/L/XL), risk (Low/Med/High), pros (2-3 points), cons (2-3 points), reuse — with one explicitly being the MVP/minimal-viable approach and one being the ideal-architecture approach. (4) Select a review mode (EXPANSION/SELECTIVE EXPANSION/HOLD SCOPE/SCOPE REDUCTION). (5) Produce the 6 mandatory review sections: zero silent failures, named exceptions (not bare catches), three shadow paths per data flow (nil, empty, upstream error), edge cases for user-visible interactions, observability as first-class deliverable (dashboards/alerts/runbooks), and at least one ASCII art diagram for the data flow. (6) Leverage specific design doc constraints: 200ms latency limit, BAA/HIPAA requirement preventing PHI to external APIs, feature flag ff_drug_interaction_ai, confidence threshold 0.85, prescriber SMS notification chain. (7) Output the exact proprietary report format with ════ separator borders and all mandatory fields including a valid status (DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT). The proprietary traps: effort labels must be S/M/L/XL; one alternative must be explicitly labeled MVP and one as ideal architecture; ASCII diagram is mandatory not optional; status must be one of exactly four values; error mapping must name specific exception types not generic catches.
